result.text:
What is UEFA thinking? Are they blind? Do they really believe they can bully FIFA and Infantino when he has the full political and financial backing of the United States? 

What blindness from UEFA They think they can corner Infantino while FIFA has the political and financial weight of the United States behind it. Pull the rope too hard, and they’ll find Washington launching a legal investigation that will make FIFA Gate look like child’s play. They’re gambling with their own existence.

UEFA should be careful about acting arrogant toward the United States. When the American market and its investment funds decide to fully embrace a sport, they don’t ask for permission—they reshape the entire business. UEFA believes it controls global football, but if the entertainment giants, streaming platforms, and American sponsors decide to turn their backs on the European model, UEFA will quickly discover who really holds the purse strings. Less arrogance and more diplomacy, because you don’t toy with the American giant.

UEFA should choose its words very carefully before declaring war on initiatives driven from the United States. Have they already forgotten that when the U.S. justice system and the Department of Justice stepped into FIFA Gate, the entire structure of world football was shaken? If the United States decides to apply commercial or legal pressure against UEFA’s monopoly, no official statement will be enough to save them. You’re picking a fight with the country that hosts the biggest sporting spectacles on the planet. A little humility wouldn’t hurt.
